specification.outcome: When a user asks in normal conversation to create an ordinary ticket, Tiber publishes an unclaimed Backlog task without requiring or changing a campaign.

scenarios.name: create a ticket without a campaign checkpoint
given: the signed task board is writable
create-task title and description pass existing parsers
then: host generates one task UUID, event UUID, and canonical UTC time and publishes existing task-created event
task is Backlog with specificationDigest, specification, claim, and campaignProvenance all {kind:'none'}
FileCampaignStore is never constructed, read, or written

scenarios.name: create a ticket while an unrelated campaign is active
given: the signed task board is writable
then: ordinary task-created event is published without campaign ID
active campaign bytes are unchanged and FileCampaignStore is never constructed, read, or written by this operation

scenarios.name: reject malformed create request
given: create-task has a missing, unknown, null, or wrong-typed kind, title, or description field
then: no identifier, clock, task remote, campaign, readiness, claim, or worktree operation occurs

scenarios.name: reject invalid task metadata
given: closed create-task has title or description rejected by parseTaskTitle or parseTaskDescription
then: no event or campaign operation occurs

scenarios.name: reject read-only or failed publication
given: signed task authority is degraded read-only or GitTaskRemote cannot sign, verify, push, observe, or reconcile after four attempts
then: the existing TIBER_TASK_BOARD_INVALID failure is returned
no successful task result is returned and no campaign operation occurs

scenarios.name: route ordinary ticket language directly
given: the user says 'Add a ticket: Fix the startup lag' or 'Create a ticket titled Fix lag with description Render activity immediately'
when: Pi forms the next tool call
then: payload is respectively {kind:'create-task',title:'Fix the startup lag',description:''} or {kind:'create-task',title:'Fix lag',description:'Render activity immediately'}
a request with no inferable title is not sent and receives TIBER_WORKFLOW_REQUEST_INVALID guidance
it does not use campaign-goal or begin-task

scenarios.name: preserve campaign language routing
given: the user says 'Start a campaign to finish every backlog ticket'
when: Pi forms the next tool call

scenarios.name: return the created task identity and state
given: the exact task-created event is published and independently projected
then: content text is 'Task created: <taskId>\nBacklog | unspecified | unclaimed'

acceptanceCriteria: Workflow schema exact shape is {kind:'create-task',title:string,description:string}; every key required and unknown keys rejected.

Metadata uses existing parseTaskTitle and parseTaskDescription unchanged. If natural language omits description, inference supplies empty string; if no title can be inferred, no create effect is requested.

Host constructs schemaVersion:1 task-created with one lowercase randomUUID v4 eventId, one lowercase randomUUID v4 task.id, new Date().toISOString occurredAt, parsed title/description, and no model-selected authority fields.
GitTaskRemote receives the same immutable event object for all of its existing maximum four publication attempts, so task ID, event ID, time, and metadata never change across races.

Projected successful Task has state 'Backlog', blockStatus 'unblocked', specification/specificationDigest/claim/finalReviewProgress/completionRelease/delivery/ci/openedReview/reviewReceipt/campaignProvenance each {kind:'none'}, preservedIncrements [], and no campaign identity.
Create dispatch does not import, construct, read, or write FileCampaignStore and invokes no readiness reviewer, work command, run journal, or worktree adapter.
All publication failures preserve existing GitTaskRemote degraded-read-only TIBER_TASK_BOARD_INVALID result and cannot be formatted as success.
The registered TypeBox workflow tool schema, parser, automatic guidance, deterministic dispatcher, and result capture all include create-task while existing campaign routing is unchanged.
dependencies: src/extension/workflow-request-tool.ts TypeBox registration, randomUUID/Date authority generation, dispatch, and result capture
src/core/tasks/task-board.ts task-created event and Option projection
specification.architectureImplications: Add one closed create-task request interpreted through existing signed TaskCreatedEvent publication. Inference supplies metadata only; host generates identifiers/time and never invokes campaign, readiness, or work transitions.
